title: Handlebar Dash
tagline: A round digital dash on its own handlebar clamp, replacing the stock instruments.
summary: A 2.8" round colour display that reads the bike's own signals (speed, fuel, gear, indicators, warning lights) and adds its own: GPS speed and trip, clock, battery voltage, air temperature, lean angle and g-force. A standard OBD-II port and three expansion slots let it grow. First bike: the J-platform 350 with the J1D3 harness (the Meteor 350).
status: Phase 1 (learning the bike's CAN bus) is ready to build, and the display head is modelled (v1, checked in CAD, not printed yet): a round housing around the Waveshare 2.8" display, a carrier, a back cover, a sun hood with the GPS antenna, and a handlebar clamp with a GoPro-style joint. The interface box comes next.

see_sub: Modelled around Waveshare's published drawing and 3D model of the 2.8" display: the housing is 102.5 mm across and 39.6 mm deep.

gallery.caption: From the rider's seat: the 2.8" round screen (70 mm visible) behind a thin lip, the sun hood on top, the clamp below
From the side: the hood reaches 28 mm past the screen; the head tilts on its joint (clear of the clamp at any angle from 0 to 60 degrees)
Taken apart: the shell, the carrier (the display screws to it with its own 4 standoffs), the back cover with the joint, and the hood

head_shell.name: Shell
head_shell.what: The round housing with the thin front lip. The display slides in from the back
head_shell.material: PETG (ASA for the final part). Lip face down, no supports

head_carrier.name: Carrier
head_carrier.what: The display screws to it (4 x M2 x 6 into its own standoffs); the GPS module and the CAN board go on its back

head_cover.name: Back cover
head_cover.what: Closes the back, presses the display onto the foam ring, carries the GoPro-style joint and the GX12 socket
head_cover.material: PETG, 4 perimeters (the joint). Plug edge down, joint up

head_hood.name: Sun hood
head_hood.what: Shades the screen; the GPS antenna sits under it (plastic doesn't block GPS)
head_hood.material: PETG. Standing on its front edge

lip_gasket.name: Foam ring
lip_gasket.what: 0.8 mm ring between the lip and the glass. Print in TPU, or cut it from 0.8 mm closed-cell foam

clamp_upper.name: Clamp, upper
clamp_upper.what: Around the bar, with the 2 fingers of the joint (fits the cover's 3)

clamp_lower.name: Clamp, lower
clamp_lower.what: The other half, with traps for 2 M4 nuts

head_assembled.name: Display head, assembled
head_assembled.what: The head on its clamp, with a simplified display (view only)
